objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation prefix used in the document name to identify its type.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the document, incremented upon revisions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The defined time period for validity checks, default 3 years per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Defined retention period after invalidation before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications linked to the document via properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies associated with the document maintained in properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas of validity for the document maintained in properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment defining read authorizations for the document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person assigned as the primary author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check and release translated versions of the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons notified by email upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Level 1 document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Level 2 document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Level 3 document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Level 4 document type describing detailed special work steps in sub-processes, supplemented with forms and checklists.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle, released directly via switches.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing document without affecting content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering a workflow for suspension processing.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request created to re-validate previously invalidated documents, triggering an automatic workflow.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as reader, author, reviewer, releaser, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign authorizations and distribution lists to documents.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity to which documents can be linked within the system.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing and management.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents within the system.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application master data object that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons maintained per document who are informed about document releases via email or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to complete their tasks, documented per released version.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that manages the steps of document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view displaying relevant documents and evaluation information based on distribution group assignments.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation providing filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The specific type of report (e.g., Status report, Search for documents, Status report for acknowledgement).

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in the multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The author edits the content of a document using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via property editing in the system.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval workflow for a document.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness and completes the task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, completing the task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when revisions or triggering changes occur.

evts.name: attach_additional_info
evts.description: An author attaches additional information to a document that is not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly due to its lack of criticality.

evts.name: attach_equippment
evts.description: An author attaches a controlled equippment document to the main document.

evts.name: archive_equippment
evts.description: An equippment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for a document to suggest changes without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of assigned change proposals, triggering notification to the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or workflow participants confirm extended validity, updating the Valid Until date and deleting the request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a document and start the suspension workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force after the override workflow is completed, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A business admin group member creates a request for reactivation selecting the invalidated document to be reactivated.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation in the workflow, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read and change authorizations are assigned to user groups and persons for a specific document via property editing.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released with workflow support by assigned participants.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: Policy is a specific document type at Level 1 in the document hierarchy.
Guideline is a specific document type at Level 2 in the document hierarchy.
Procedural Instruction is a specific document type at Level 3 in the document hierarchy.
Work Instruction is a specific document type at Level 4 in the document hierarchy.
Additional Info is attached to a document as supplementary non-controlled content.
Equippment is attached to a document as a controlled attachment released with the main document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
A Request for Override is created for a document to invalidate and archive it.
A Request for Reactivation references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Documents can reference and be linked to other documents in the system.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to risks.
Documents can be linked to IT applications as master data references.
Each document has a distribution list defining who is informed about releases.
Each document in a multi-client system specifies in which clients it is visible.
Distribution lists contain assigned user groups for email or acknowledgement distribution.
Distribution lists contain directly assigned persons for email or acknowledgement distribution.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant them specific roles and authorizations.
